name: Unique Menu Icons
description: Gives every Gen 1 Pokemon its own unique party/menu icon instead of the vanilla shared body-type icons (QUADRUPED, BIRD, SNAKE, etc); includes vanilla icon colors and recolored to the authentic Gen 2 red palette (SGB + Advanced) as a toggle (has a side effect of recoloring some other sprites). Icon art: MiniDex sprites by Chamber, Solo0993, Blue Emerald, Lake, Neslug and Pikachu25.
